_comment: Sample deny-list. Edit for your team; this file ships committed to the repo, unlike secrets. deny_filenames and tokens_file are the two layers this hook is actually best at -- no off-the-shelf scanner knows your codenames. deny_filenames: regex matched against EVERY COMPONENT of the staged path, not only the basename, so ^\.env$ also catches a *directory* named .env. deny_regexes: regex matched against staged file CONTENT (bytes). tokens_file (optional): a plain-text file, one literal string per line, byte-exact, for client names, internal hostnames and project aliases -- keep that file out of the repo if the literals are sensitive.
